*Time-Of-Use Rate Plans let you take advantage of the hours of the day when energy is less expensive for us to produce so you pay less too. Off-Peak (11pm-6am) - 8¢ per kWH versus 13¢ per kWH for Flat Rate Plan (anytime).
com.bidgely.cloud.email.tou.onboarding.w: Your Time of Use Rate Can Help You Save Big on Your Bills

Time of Use (TOU) rates are a great way to save a lot on your energy bills, help keep the grid stable, and possibly reduce your carbon impact. All you need to do is move your peak time usage away to off-peak hours. We will help you in this journey so you  can realize the bill savings.

com.bidgely.cloud.email.tou.rate.structu: On the Time-of-Day (TOD) Off-Peak Rate, electricity prices are based on when you use energy (peak and off-peak periods). You can save by using high-energy-use appliances before 3 PM and after 7 PM on weekdays and anytime on weekends and federal holidays.
During weekends, peak times are ${peakHrs}. Times differ by season.
Weekends and holidays do not have any peak hours. The rate type differs by season.
